en.intro: After Krishna rebukes Arjuna for his despair, Arjuna answers with a deeper wound: how can he shoot arrows at the teachers he reveres?
en.notice: Arjuna asks how he can fight Bhishma and Drona with arrows, and calls them worthy of worship, revealing the depth of his anguish.
en.next: Sanjaya answers with the king's own son, Duryodhana, looking across at the Pandava army.
en.meaning: Arjuna says: How can I fight Bhishma and Drona with arrows in battle, O Madhusudana? They are worthy of worship, O destroyer of enemies.

hi.intro: कृष्ण की फटकार के बाद अर्जुन अपनी बात रखते हैं। भीष्म उनके पितामह हैं जिन्होंने उन्हें बचपन से पाला, और द्रोण उनके धनुर्विद्या के गुरु हैं। ये दोनों कौरव सेना की ओर से खड़े हैं, इसलिए अर्जुन का मन कर्तव्य और श्रद्धा के बीच फँस गया है।
hi.meaning: अर्जुन कहते हैं कि हे मधुसूदन, मैं रणभूमि में भीष्म पितामह और गुरु द्रोण पर बाण कैसे चलाऊँ। ये दोनों तो मेरे लिए पूजा के योग्य हैं। जिनके चरण छूने चाहिए, उन पर हथियार उठाना उन्हें असंभव लगता है।
hi.notice: अर्जुन पूछते हैं कि वे उन पर बाण कैसे चला सकते हैं जो उनके लिए पूजार्ह हैं, और यह उनके मन में चल रहे द्वंद्व को दर्शाता है।
hi.next: अर्जुन कहते हैं कि इन गुरुओं को मारना अपने ही हाथों से अपने ही गुरुओं के वध के समान है, जो उन्हें जीवन भर नहीं भूलने देगा।

en.intro: After Krishna rebukes Arjuna for his despair, Arjuna answers with a deeper wound: how can he shoot arrows at the teachers he reveres?
en.body: Arjuna says: How can I fight Bhishma and Drona with arrows in battle, O Madhusudana? They are worthy of worship, O destroyer of enemies. Arjuna asks how he can fight Bhishma and Drona with arrows, and calls them worthy of worship, revealing the depth of his anguish. Sanjaya answers with the king's own son, Duryodhana, looking across at the Pandava army.

issues: borrowed: "Arjuna says it is better to live on alms than to kill these great teachers, whose blood would stain his own life." (The 'next' notice for the English intro/notice section contains content from the NEXT verse (verse 5), not this verse. It incorrectly states that Arjuna says it is better to live on alms in this verse.)

unsupported: "Arjuna names Bhishma and Drona, and calls them worthy of worship" (The English notice states that Arjuna 'names' Bhishma and Drona, but the Sanskrit source (अर्जुन उवाच) does not include the actual naming in this specific verse; the names are introduced in the subsequent verse (verse 5). The source verse only refers to them as 'Bhishma' and 'Drona' in the instrumental plural (इषुभिः) without explicitly naming them as the objects of the fight in this exact utterance.)
